$jsonSchema.title: PaymentException
$jsonSchema.description: Stage 9 — one document per exception occurrence (doc 24 B2): a settlement that came back unmatched/returned/delayed, a reconciliation discrepancy, or a duplicate-content signal. Doina's alignment row 9 (Sep 17 L1577) says 'exceptions created' and names no v14 domain ('modeled as a state/action within the originating domain'); the collection is her TBD #13 (L1414) — 0 matches in the canonical spec (verified by count), so the shape is authored here and ratified via Q60. The reserved nullable agent{} subdoc is where the Reconciliation Agent's output lands (L1319-1323, Q61); category 'UTA' and actions 'REPAIR'/'RETURN' are reserved for the incoming flow (FR-9.IN4 / DR-9.IN1, Q64) and are never written by the outgoing path. No collection validator is applied (Q9, like every prior authored collection).

paymentId.description: Back-reference to payments.paymentId. The Operations queue joins on this; payments carries no refs[] array of exception ids (doc 24 B2). ORPHANED_SETTLEMENT has no payment: it carries `<statement paymentMessageId>#<lineNo>` here so the OPEN-unique index dedupes per line, and subjectRef names the line (plan A3 D1a).

category.description: UTA reserved for the incoming Repair/Return flow (FR-9.IN4) — never written by the outgoing path. RECONCILIATION_MISSING (an outbound wire with no correspondent statement line by settlementPositions.expectedWindow.by) and ORPHANED_SETTLEMENT (a statement line no payment claims) are written by the ledger (reconciliation plan A3; pending Doina sign-off).

status.description: OPEN until an operator resolves (RESOLVED) or dismisses (DISMISSED) via POST /workflow/exceptions/{id}/resolve. The payment's own terminal state never reopens (doc 24 B4).

severity.description: DUPLICATE_SIGNAL is the only INFORMATIONAL category this stage writes.

stage.description: The lifecycle stage whose detection raised the exception.

detail.description: Per-category payload, populated from the stamps the producers already write. Amounts are MAJOR units (float dollars), matching payments.amount / clearing.discrepancyAmount. Nullable members; only the keys relevant to the category are set.

discrepancyAmount.description: SETTLEMENT_UNMATCHED / RECONCILIATION_DISCREPANCY: expected minus received, major units.

actualAmount.description: Major units; 0 when nothing settled back.

duplicateOf.description: DUPLICATE_SIGNAL: the paymentId this one resembles (duplicate_detection WARN detail).

expectedWindowBy.description: RECONCILIATION_MISSING: when the statement line was due (settlementPositions.expectedWindow.by).

settlementPositionId.description: RECONCILIATION_MISSING: the position still awaiting its statement line.

reference.description: ORPHANED_SETTLEMENT: the reference as the correspondent booked it.

subjectRef.description: Set when the exception's subject is not a payment. ORPHANED_SETTLEMENT: the camt.053 statement line (paymentMessages, purpose ACCOUNT_STATEMENT) no internal record claims.

resolution.description: Null while OPEN. Written by the resolve endpoint (doc 24 B4): the action taken, by whom, when, and the operator's note (the resolution log, R5).

action.description: REPAIR/RETURN reserved for incoming UTA (FR-9.IN2) — never written this stage. RECHECK: the ledger auto-resolves a RECONCILIATION_MISSING once the statement line arrives (plan A3 D2); A4 adds it as an operator action. LINK_STATEMENT_ENTRY (A4): an operator paired a statement line with a payment — closes the MISSING + ORPHANED twin together. POST_ADJUSTMENT (A4): a DEBT wire's correspondent charge booked Dr 5214 / Cr nostro; reconciliation closes the leg once the -ADJ event posts. ESCALATE_TO_CORRESPONDENT is never a resolution — it is recorded in escalation{} and the exception stays OPEN.

by.description: 'payments-operations' for an operator action; a service actor when the system auto-resolves (e.g. RETRY_SETTLEMENT landing MATCHED).

awaitingCounterparty.description: Plan A4 — true once ESCALATE_TO_CORRESPONDENT sent an investigation request. The exception stays OPEN until RECHECK / LINK / POST_ADJUSTMENT / DISMISS closes it.

escalation.description: Plan A4 — the investigation request sent to the correspondent (paymentMessages, purpose INVESTIGATION_REQUEST, camt.029-style).

agent.description: Null until the Reconciliation Agent runs. Its output lands here (Sep 17 L1319-1323): investigation result, likely root cause, supporting evidence, confidence, recommended resolution. Shape ratified via Q61. Written by backend/payment_agent/reconciliation_agent.py `record_investigation` — the ONLY write that agent performs.

confidence.description: A free-text LABEL, not a numeric score — an LLM's numeric confidence is not calibrated, so the operator sees the label. Validated against this same set in `reconciliation_agent._CONFIDENCE_VALUES` before the write; an out-of-set value is refused, not coerced.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 string, not a BSON date — the agent service writes `datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()` so the value survives the JSON hop to the UI unchanged.

sourceSystem.description: Which service wrote the occurrence. Follows the reconciliationItems convention ('ledger-service'), NOT the payments/transactions docs' 'leafy-bank-payments-service'.
